exercises.question: Como se pergunta "Você já foi a Londres?"
options: Have you ever been to London?
Did you ever go to London already?
Are you ever been to London?
Have you ever went to London?
exercises.answer: Have you ever been to London?
exercises.explain: Para experiências de vida sem data, use o present perfect: have + particípio (been).

exercises.translation: Eu já li este livro duas vezes.
exercises.explain: O particípio de read se escreve igual, mas soa “réd”.
Since marca o ponto de início (since 2019); for marca a duração (for five years).
Never fica entre have e o particípio: I have never seen.
“Acabar de” costuma virar have just + particípio: they’ve just arrived.
